description:
XRP utils (Utils product): validate address, decode/encode X-Address.

Actions:
• validate-address: Check if an XRP address is valid
• decode-x-address: Decode X-Address to classic address and tag
• encode-x-address: Encode classic address and tag to X-Address

Networks: mainnet, testnet

Credits by action (source: OpenAPI):
• decode-x-address: 10
• encode-x-address: 10
• validate-address: 10

Credits are indicative only and may change at any time. The actual credits spent for each API request are returned in the response headers.
